notes: FBK-MT/Speech-MASSIVE-test spoken realisation of Amazon MASSIVE (ar-SA), evaluated end-to-end audio -> transcript -> intent. Same intent taxonomy and template training corpus as massive-templates (text-input sibling); scoped to the open 'intent' (fusion) league in v1 — the keyword-paradigm training corpus (intents-for-eval-keywords) does not cover every Speech-MASSIVE language, so intent_keyword/intent_template sub-league repos are not emitted here. The runner transcribes each clip ONCE with the pinned STT above (same ovos-stt-plugin-onnx-asr family the STT league runs), caches the transcript, and feeds it to every intent fighter — this isolates intent-ranking from STT variance; see docs/SPECIFICATION.md §3.2 for the v1-vs-combinatorial-STT×intent-fighters rationale.
